review_runs.summary: Clear, well-supported teaching of demonstrative agreement and definite nouns, with meaningful changed-context writing practice. Main defect: one choice item treats flexible demonstrative usage as categorically wrong. Minor defects include learner-facing level talk, third-person learner commentary, and one audio/text mismatch. Reviewed all 12 exercises. Every exercise serves obj-demonstrative-pronouns-01: distinguishing near/far reference, selecting demonstratives by gender and number, identifying definite noun forms, or combining these skills in contextual use. Focused subskill exercises remain aligned without testing every part of the objective.
